mapper.select: select id, status, data_count as dataCount, current_data_id as currentDataId, ci_collection_id as ciCollectionId, transaction_group_id as transactionGroupId, config as configStr from cmdb_sync_audit where id = #{value}

select id, ci_collection_id as ciCollectionId, data_id as dataId, collection_name as collectionName, error as errorListStr from cmdb_sync_data_audit
limit #{startNum},#{pageSize}
select count(a.id) from cmdb_sync_audit a join cmdb_sync_ci_collection b on a.ci_collection_id = b.id

select a.id, a.ci_collection_id AS ciCollectionId, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime, a.input_from AS inputFrom, a.status, a.transaction_group_id AS transactionGroupId, a.server_id AS serverId, a.error AS error from cmdb_sync_audit a where a.server_id = #{value} and (a.status = 'doing' or a.status = 'pausing')

select a.id, a.ci_collection_id AS ciCollectionId, a.start_time AS startTime, a.end_time AS endTime, a.input_from AS inputFrom, a.status, a.transaction_group_id AS transactionGroupId, a.server_id AS serverId, a.error AS error from cmdb_sync_audit a join cmdb_sync_ci_collection b on a.ci_collection_id = b.id where b.ci_id = #{value} and (a.status = 'doing' or a.status = 'pausing')

select data_id as dataId, data_hash as dataHash, update_time as updateTime, collection_name as collectionName from cmdb_sync_data_hash where data_id = #{dataId} and collection_name = #{collectionName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cmdb_sync_audit (id, ci_collection_id, start_time, input_from, status, transaction_group_id, server_id, config) VALUES (#{id}, #{ciCollectionId}, NOW(3), #{inputFrom}, #{status}, #{transactionGroupId}, #{serverId}, #{configStr, typeHandler=CompressHandler})

insert into cmdb_sync_data_audit (id, ci_collection_id, collection_name, data_id, audit_id, error) values (#{id}, #{ciCollectionId}, #{collectionName}, #{dataId}, #{auditId}, #{errorListStr, typeHandler=CompressHandler}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE audit_id = #{auditId}, error = #{errorListStr, typeHandler=CompressHandler}

insert into cmdb_sync_data_hash (data_id, data_hash, update_time, collection_name) values (#{dataId}, #{dataHash}, now(), #{collectionName}) on duplicate key update data_hash = #{dataHash}, update_time = now()
mapper.delete: delete a,b from cmdb_sync_audit a left join cmdb_sync_data_audit b on a.id = b.audit_id where (a.status = 'done' or a.status = 'paused') and a.end_time < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL #{value} DAY)
delete from cmdb_sync_data_hash where update_time < DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE, INTERVAL #{value} DAY)
